warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the cross-species LBO operator (`cross_nu`, the Greene-weighted exchange of momentum and energy between species), untouched by the single-species LBO checks. In `rt_vlasov_lbo_cross_1x1v_p2.c`, `n0_neut1` (line 79) is the reference density of the heavy species; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong cross-collision frequency, a wrong momentum or energy exchange or a wrong primitive-moment solve changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-11, rtol=1e-11 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 1.8e-4 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 1.7e-4 (worst files `neut2-imom.gkyl` and `neut2-imom.gkyl`), a headroom of about 5545x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
